nodes.label: Nightly Contribution Sweep
nodes.rationale: Diff against the agent-vX.Y.Z tag, never upstream/master: the workspace is a subset of the monorepo (no core/, tests/, frontend), so a raw diff against master is polluted with phantom deletions. The sweep also catches local-only files that never existed upstream and would otherwise silently never be contributed. Go within each file: the unit of contribution is the improvement, not the file.

nodes.label: Four Filing Gates
nodes.rationale: Grep first for an existing implementation in the natural layer (duplicated logic is a smell); generalizable goes upstream, user-specific stays local; PR bodies carry the closing keyword because GitHub only auto-closes on merge from the body; strip personal information because upstream is public.
